entry.name: Blastoise Gigantamax
entry.flavorEs: Dispara chorros de agua a través de los cañones de su caparazón, capaces de agujerear incluso el acero.
entry.flavorZh: 从龟壳上的大炮里 放出的喷射水流 足以贯穿厚实的铁板。

abilities.textEn: At 1/3 or less of its max HP, this Pokemon's offensive stat is 1.5x with Water attacks.
abilities.textEs: Potencia sus movimientos de tipo Agua cuando le quedan pocos PS.
abilities.detail: When this Pokemon has 1/3 or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Water-type attack.
abilities.detailEs: Cuando a este Pokémon le queda 1/3 o menos de sus PS, sus movimientos de tipo Agua infligen 1.5× de daño normal.
abilities.detailZh: 当该宝可梦剩余HP为1/3或以下时，其水属性招式造成1.5×的常规伤害。
abilities.detailPt: Quando este Pokémon tem 1/3 ou menos do seu HP restante, seus movimentos do tipo Água infligem 1.5× o dano normal.

abilities.textEn: If Rain Dance is active, this Pokemon heals 1/16 of its max HP each turn.
abilities.textEs: Recupera PS de forma gradual cuando llueve.
abilities.detail: If Rain Dance is active, this Pokemon restores 1/16 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn. This effect is prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.
abilities.detailEs: Este Pokémon recupera 1/16 de sus PS máximos después de cada turno durante la lluvia.
abilities.detailZh: 下雨时，该宝可梦在每回合结束后回复其最大HP的1/16。
abilities.detailPt: Este Pokémon recupera 1/16 do seu HP máximo após cada turno durante a chuva.
